title: SecOps-NG Patch Application Evidence Artifact
description: Typed shape for one evidence artifact emitted by the patch-application evidence stream. One artifact is produced per scheduled execution of `playbook.patch_management@v1` and pins, mechanically, (a) the tracked update subject + advisory reference resolved at the detect step, (b) the classified patch criticality against the closed taxonomy (`security-critical`, `security-routine`, `feature-only`) or the `unclassified` sentinel on the deadline-missed branch, (c) the staged canary ring identifier the stage-rollout step engaged, (d) the canary health outcome from the validate-canary step, (e) the broad rollout identifier from the fan-out step (empty on the canary-unhealthy branch with an explicit skip marker), and (f) the observed health-gate measurements across the validation window. The artifact is compile-target-agnostic: the deterministic `artifact_id` keys on `<workflow_id>|<execution_id>|<captured_at>` and does NOT include the compile target, so the three reference compilers (n8n, Temporal, LangGraph) re-derive byte-identical bytes from the same primitive output. Public-bar artifact: subject / advisory / ring identifiers stay opaque operator-side strings; individual personal names, credential-shaped strings, and raw configuration secret material are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Lets a consumer reject artifacts produced under an older schema once breaking changes ship.

artifact_id.description: Stable per-artifact identifier. Convention: SHA-256 hex digest of `<workflow_id>|<execution_id>|<captured_at>` (UTF-8, no separators around the pipes). Deterministic on those three inputs; re-emissions inside the same execution at the same `captured_at` instant stay byte-identical at the path level. Compile target is intentionally NOT part of the id so the three reference compilers re-derive byte-identical bytes from the same primitive output (this is the byte-parity contract the F-WF-PATCH CORE-FANOUT siblings assert against).

stream.description: Identifies which evidence stream produced the artifact. Constant on this schema.

workflow_id.description: Stable workflow identifier; pinned to `patch_management` for this stream.

execution_id.description: Per-execution identifier issued by the compile target's workflow runtime (n8n execution id, Temporal workflow run id, LangGraph thread/checkpoint id).

regulation_refs.description: Pins to the upstream regulatory mapping entries this artifact helps satisfy. The patch_management playbook anchors against `nis2:art-21-2-e` (security in acquisition, development and maintenance), `dora:art-9-maintenance-patch-rollout` (per-event maintenance / patch-rollout slice under JC RTS Art. 10), and `cra:annex-i-2-security-updates-rollout` (per-event maintenance-rollout limb of Annex I §2).

control_refs.description: Control stable-ids attested by this artifact. The patch_management playbook anchors against `control.patch_evidence@v1` (NIST SP 800-53 SI-2 / SI-2(2)).

update_subject.description: Opaque operator-side identifier of the tracked package / image / firmware line the update applies to (matches a row in the operator's documented deployment-inventory). Role-shaped or URN-shaped; personal-name strings rejected at the primitive boundary.

update_reference.description: Opaque operator-side identifier of the security update / patch advisory being rolled out (advisory id, vendor reference, upstream release tag).

patch_criticality.description: Closed taxonomy bucket for this update against the operator's documented patch-criticality taxonomy. `unclassified` is the sentinel emitted on the deadline-missed short-circuit branch; downstream reviewers treat the update as security-critical for scheduling urgency.

staged_ring_id.description: Deterministic identifier of the canary ring the staged-rollout step engaged the update against. Always populated; the value names the ring that received the update on the staged branch even on the short-circuit branch.

canary_healthy.description: Outcome of the validate-canary step. `true` when the canary ring is observed inside the documented health gates (functional probes green, error-rate / latency deviation inside the documented thresholds, rollback path verified) for the documented validation window; `false` when the canary is unhealthy and the broad rollout was paused.

broad_rollout_id.description: Deterministic identifier of the broad-ring rollout engagement once the canary has reported healthy. Empty string on the canary-unhealthy branch (the fan-out step is a deterministic skip leaving the broad-rollout id empty with an explicit skip marker on `broad_rollout_skip_reason`).

broad_rollout_skip_reason.description: Explicit skip marker emitted when the fan-out step is deterministically skipped. Required iff `broad_rollout_id` is empty.

health_observations.description: Observed health-gate measurements across the validation window. The closed set mirrors the CACAO gate inputs: functional probe outcome, error-rate / latency deviation, rollback readiness.

functional_probe.description: Closed enum: `green` (probe succeeded), `red` (probe failed), `unknown` (probe did not report inside the validation window).

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC second-precision timestamp at which this artifact was captured. Part of `artifact_id` so two captures at the same instant against the same execution stay byte-identical, and re-runs at different instants do not collide.

provenance.description: Where this artifact came from. Mirrors the provenance pattern used by the other evidence streams so a reviewer can re-derive the chain back to source.

source_url.description: URL of the workflow run that produced this artifact. Compile targets may use their own run-id URLs; the URL itself is opaque to this schema.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp matching the artifact-level `captured_at`.

commit_sha.description: Optional commit SHA of the content snapshot the workflow walked.

owner.description: Optional dated ownership pointer for the maintenance posture this artifact covers. Role-shaped — a working-group mailbox, a generic role title, or a community handle. Individual personal names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3 and rejected here as a matter of schema discipline.

retention.description: Optional retention pointer the operator declares for this evidentiary record. ISO-8601 duration, defaulted by the operator's configuration.

allOf.description: Skip-marker invariant: broad_rollout_skip_reason is present iff broad_rollout_id is the empty string. Captured as conditional allOf clauses so a reviewer can derive the failure mode either way.
